findings.title: 503 is retried once and the recovered response is returned
findings.remediation: Add bounded retry for 429/502/503/504 in SafeFetcher or document that callers must retry.

findings.title: 429 is retried once and the recovered response is returned
findings.remediation: Honor Retry-After with a bounded retry budget; never retry indefinitely.

notes: Superseded by a Python 3.14.0 rerun; retained for audit.
